Hybrid Quantum Computing:

  • I gained hands-on experience using the Qoro Quantum divi library to architect a distributed computing framework.
  • I learned how to balance computational loads between classical and quantum nodes, effectively managing the handshake between the two environments.

Algorithmic Parallelization:

  • I developed a deep understanding of the Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE) by parallelizing instances to simulate the hydrogen molecule.
  • This allowed for the precise identification of optimal bond lengths and ground state energies.

Advanced Ansatz Engineering:

  • I gained experience in the design of hardware-efficient custom ansätze. By developing a scalable alternative to the UCCSD (Unitary Coupled Cluster) ansatz for Ammonia,
  • I successfully matched industry-standard accuracy while drastically reducing circuit depth and gate overhead.

item.title: Qiskit Bootcamp
item.description:
Qiskit Fall Fest 2025: PushQuantum Online Bootcamp

IBM Quantum Event | 2025

I deepened technical proficiency in quantum computing through an intensive bootcamp focused on the IBM Quantum ecosystem and the Qiskit framework.

Key Competencies Gained:

1. Quantum Programming & Development: I Developed and executed quantum circuits using Python and Qiskit, gaining hands-on experience with the full development lifecycle.

2. Hardware Execution & Scaling: I mastered the process of submitting jobs to IBM Quantum backends and explored strategies for scaling algorithms to a larger number of qubits.

item.title: Quantum Computing and Programming Workshop
item.description:
QWorld: QBronze Online Entangling Workshop

Through this intensive program, I transitioned from classical programming logic to quantum-native development using Python and Qiskit. I developed a basic foundation in quantum mechanics and the algorithmic structures that drive the next generation of computing.

Key Knowledge & Technical Milestones

1. Quantum Circuit Engineering Qiskit Integration: Mastered the workflow for designing, building, and executing quantum circuits on simulated environments.

State Manipulation: Developed an intuition for quantum superposition and the application of the Hadamard Operator to create probabilistic states.
